_about: Public-domain Thomas of Marga (9th century), bishop and monastic historian of the Church of the East, for the Word Hoard: The Book of Governors, the Historia Monastica, vol. II, the English translation, edited by E. A. Wallis Budge (1893), from an Internet Archive scan. Added 2026-10-18 by lane A, round 38 (my pick); Adam may veto the whole shelf. Every printing dated before 1930, so public domain in the US. No uids minted.
